aboutText: Based in Tullamarine, Auto Comfort is Melbourne's go-to destination for all vehicle comfort needs. From sunroof installation and repairs to truck cooling systems and professional motor trimming, we deliver quality results for cars, trucks, and boats. Our skilled team works with leading brands like Coolabah and Autoclima to ensure every job is completed to the highest standard across Tullamarine and Melbourne's north-west.
servicesText: Auto Comfort in Tullamarine offers comprehensive vehicle comfort services including sunroof installation and repairs, truck cooling systems, and expert motor trimming and upholstery for cars, trucks, boats, and commercial vehicles across Melbourne's north-west.

services.title: Sunroof Installation
services.desc: Professional sunroof installation for all vehicle types, including top slider and integrated sunroofs, with quality guaranteed.

services.title: Sunroof Repairs
services.desc: Expert sunroof repairs to fix leaks, jams, and mechanical issues, restoring your sunroof to full functionality.

services.title: Sunroof Damage Assessments
services.desc: Comprehensive sunroof damage assessments to identify issues and recommend the best repair or replacement solutions.

services.title: Truck Cooling Systems
services.desc: Installation and repair of truck cooling systems using top brands like Coolabah and Autoclima for reliable performance.

services.title: Automotive Motor Trimming
services.desc: Professional motor trimming and upholstery for vehicles, including seat repairs, door trims, and custom interior work.

services.title: Marine and Industrial Upholstery
services.desc: Specialised upholstery services for boats, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications using durable high-quality materials.
